name: Michelle de La Farge
original_name: ミシェル・ドゥ・ラ・ファージュ
source:
A young lady who came from France to study at Shirasagi Academy for "certain reasons". 
Born and raised in a French military family, she has a strict character and hates to lose. 
Her disciplined and honest character is a hindrance to her honesty towards the protagonist.
She is an expert in fencing and is currently unmatched at the point of her sabre.
She also has a mysterious peculiar physique that causes her to transform into a 'tomboyish loli' when she gets her period. (Whether the cause is genetic, super-dimensional or cosmic is still a mystery.)
She is a great lover of Japan, and is particularly fond of 'Bordeaux-style okonomiyaki'.

Max End-Game Stat 
Bust: 128 --> 134 cm.
Cup size: T --> V (VVV)
